samples.text: ∀ x. ∀ y. (IsSemigroup(x, y)) ↔ ((IsSet(x)) ∧ (IsMap(y, x × x, x)) ∧ (∀ z. ∀ x_1. ∀ y_1. (z ∈ x) → (x_1 ∈ x) → (y_1 ∈ x) → ((op(y, op(y, z, x_1), y_1)) = (op(y, z, op(y, x_1, y_1))))))
∀ x. ∀ y. ∀ z. (IsMonoid(x, y, z)) ↔ ((IsSemigroup(x, y)) ∧ (z ∈ x) ∧ (∀ x_1. (x_1 ∈ x) → (((op(y, z, x_1)) = x_1) ∧ ((op(y, x_1, z)) = x_1))))
(op(m, op(m, x, y), z)) = (op(m, x, op(m, y, z)))
